items.headline: Balochistan: checkpoint par car bomb, 5 ki maut
items.detail: Mastung jile ke Kandawa area me Frontier Corps checkpoint par visfotak se bhari car takraai; hamle me 3 hamlaavar aur 2 nagrik mare gaye, 13 ghayal hue — pratibandhit BLA ne zimmedari li.
items.exam_angle: Balochistan me suraksha chunauti aur Pakistan ke andar aatankwad — Dakshin Asia ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bahrain: America ne 2 Iranian drone giraye
items.detail: CENTCOM ke mutabik Iran ne Bahrain ki taraf do hamlaavar drone bheje, dono ko America ne gira diya — koi nuksan nahi; Iran ke radar par hamle ke daave ko America ne galat bataya.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav aur Bahrain me US sainya upasthiti — West Asia ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nairobi ke paas imarat dhahi: 6 ki maut
items.detail: Shukravar subah Syokimau me nirmanadheen aath-manzila imarat ki upari slab girne se 6 log mare gaye, 5 ghayal hue; 2026 me Kenya me ye 24vaan imarat hadsa hai.
items.exam_angle: Kenya me nirman suraksha aur shahri vikas — vikasheel deshon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me LNG tanker par mine hamla
items.detail: IRGC ke mutabik Hormuz Strait me ek LNG tanker ne samudri surang (mine) se takkar khaai aur usme dhamaka hua; tanker ne 'bina anumati' wala rasta liya tha — tanker ka naam aur nuksan ki jaankari abhi nahi mili.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait duniya ke tel aur gas vyapar ka sabse mahatvapurna rasta hai — energy suraksha ke liye ahem.

items.headline: North Korea ke hackers ne $400M crypto churaya
items.detail: FBI ke mutabik North Korea samarthit hackers ne pichhle 18 mahine me nakli Zoom/Teams video call ke zariye $400 million se zyada cryptocurrency churayi; 'FaceStealer' naam ki is chaal me peediton ki webcam recording dikhakar malware install karaya gaya — FBI ne 900 se zyada victim video jabt kiye.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur cryptocurrency apradh — digital Bharat aur global cyber kanoon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Saudi: EU Houthi ko aatankwadi ghoshit kare
items.detail: Saudi Arabia EU par dabav bana raha hai ki Iran samarthit Houthi sangathan ko aatankwadi sangathan ghoshit kiya jaye; chhah European adhikariyon ke mutabik zyadatar EU desh isse shanti vaarta ko nuksan ka darr batakar hichkich rahe hain — faisle ke liye 27 deshon ki sarvasammati chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh aur EU ki videsh neeti — antarrashtriya sangathan aur West Asia ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Moscow me car bomb: ek afsar ki maut
items.detail: Shukravar ko Moscow me car bomb se Ukraine ke poorv PM ke salaahkaar Sergei Zavorotny gambhir ghayal hue; guruvaar ko St. Petersburg me car bomb se ek sainya afsar ki maut hui thi — do din me doosra hamla.
items.exam_angle: Russia ke andar chhaya yuddh aur hatya ke prayas — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Guinea: khanan pratibandh par jhadap, 10 ki maut
items.detail: Budhvaar ko Siguiri kshetra me pratibandh ki jaanch ke dauraan suraksha balon se jhadap me 10 log mare gaye, jinme paanch videshi nagrik shamil hain; 13 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Africa me sonaa khanan, paryavaran aur pravasi shramik — vikas aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ne Finland ko NATO chhodne ko kaha
items.detail: German akhbaar Bild ki report ke mutabik Abu Dhabi vaarta me Russia ne Finland se NATO chhodne aur Baltic deshon me NATO adde par rok ki maang rakhi; Kremlin ke pravakta Peskov ne is daave se inkaar kiya.
items.exam_angle: NATO vistar aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Rory Arnold / No 10 Downing Street, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

items.headline: Indonesia ke up-rashtrapati Gibran ne istifa diya
items.detail: Shiksha yogyata par sawal aur mahabhiyog ke dabav ke beech Gibran Rakabuming Raka ne istifa de diya; sansad 2 December ko naye up-rashtrapati ka chunaav karegi.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia, up-rashtrapati chunaav aur samvaidhanik prakriya — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Darwis Triadi & Ministry of State Secretariat, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Iran ne IAEA ko kaha: nirikshan abhi nahi
items.detail: Iran ne UN parmanu agency ko bataya ki America ke hamle ki dhamki ke beech parmanu nirikshan par baat-cheet nahi ho sakti; IAEA ne uranium bhandar ki sthiti ki jaankari na milne par chinta jatayi.
items.exam_angle: IAEA, parmanu nigrani aur Iran — antarrashtriya sangathan aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Norway court ne teen tel licence radd kiye
items.detail: Norway ki Supreme Court ne Tyrving, Breidablikk aur Yggdrasil kshetron ke teen tel licence avaidh kar diye, kyunki tel jalane se hone wale utsarjan ka aaklan nahi hua tha; tel utpadan par turant asar nahi padega.
items.exam_angle: Jalvayu mukadma, Scope 3 utsarjan aur Norway ki tel neeti — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya kanoon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: ASEAN: online scam par sakht kadam
items.detail: Manila shikhar sammelan me ASEAN netaon ne online scam aur manav taskari par 'gambhir chinta' jatayi; draft bayan me America aur China samet sahyogiyon ke saath milkar karwai ka vaada hai.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, cyber-aparadh aur manav taskari — antarrashtriya sangathan aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ke NYAY vibhag par Congress ki jaanch
items.detail: Democrat bahumat wali Congress ke saamne NYAY vibhag ki jaanch ka daur shuru hoga; Attorney General Blanche ne kaha vibhag peeche nahi hatega, jabki ek sahayak ne abhiyojakon ko 'yuddh-stariya' taiyari ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: America me karyapalika-vidhayika santulan aur nyayik swatantrata — rajneeti vigyan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ne Japan se sainik kharch teen guna manga
items.detail: Trump prashasan ne 2027 se paanch saal ke liye sainikon ki mejbani par 3 trillion yen (lagbhag $19 arab) ki maang ki; Japan lagbhag aadha, 1.5 trillion yen, dene par vichaar kar raha hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Japan suraksha gathbandhan aur raksha kharch — antarrashtriya sambandhon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pakistan: chhaapon me 74 aatankvadi mare gaye
items.detail: Pakistan sena ne Balochistan aur Khyber Pakhtunkhwa me 3 November se chale abhiyaanon me 74 aatankvadiyon ko maarne ka daava kiya; hathiyaar aur visfotak bhi baramad hue.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me aatankvaad-virodhi abhiyaan — padosi deshon ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Volgograd par 1,198 drone, 4 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ke mutabik raat bhar Ukraine ne lagbhag 1,198 drone bheje — Volgograd ke audyogik kshetra me hamle me 4 karmchari mare aur 2 ghayal hue; 15 se zyada kshetron me drone roke gaye.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur drone hamle — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Jalvayu vitt par UN pramukh ka zor
items.detail: Antalya me chal rahe COP31 me UN jalvayu pramukh Simon Stiell ne kaha desh apne vittiya vaade poore karein aur 2035 tak adaptation finance teen guna karne ki koshish tez ho.
items.exam_angle: COP31 aur jalvayu vitt — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sammelan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ki chetavni: America ki madad dushmani
items.detail: Iran ke videsh mantralaya ne kaha America ke khilaf karwai me sainya ya rasad madad dene wale deshon ko dushman mana jayega — nausena, sainya upkaran ya karmiyon ki madad bhi isme shamil.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur West Asia tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan PM Takaichi pehli baar China jayengi
items.detail: Japan ki PM Sanae Takaichi 16–19 November ko Philippines aur China jayengi — Shenzhen me APEC shikhar sammelan me hissa lengi; PM banne ke baad unki pehli China yatra hai, Taiwan par unke bayan ke baad se dono deshon ke rishte tanav me hain.
items.exam_angle: Japan-China sambandh aur APEC — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: Bahrain me US radar nishana
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ne daava kiya ki unhone Bahrain me America ke early-warning radar ko nishana banaya — Sirik me telecom tower par hawai hamle ka badla bataya; America ya Bahrain ki taraf se abhi koi pushti nahi aayi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur West Asia me America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UN ne Houthi pratibandh 2027 tak badhaye
items.detail: UN Suraksha Parishad ne sarvasammati se Yemen par pratibandh badhaye — Houthi netaon par sampatti-jabti aur yatra-pratibandh 14 November 2027 tak, aur drone-missile banane wale dohre-upyog wale saman par rok kadi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sankat aur UN pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ne Vance ko Iran vaarta se hataya
items.detail: Trump ne kaha America ko Iran se koi samjhauta nahi chahiye aur up-rashtrapati JD Vance ko Iran vaarta se hatakar gharelu dhokhadhadi ke khilaf abhiyan par lagaya; Vance ne yuddh ki rajnaitik keemat par sawal uthaye the.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Finland: Baltic me Russian jahaaz par hamla
items.detail: Finland ki sena ne Gulf of Finland me ek Russian yuddhpot par hamle ka pata lagaya; Ukraine ki Security Service ne hamle ki zimmedari li — Finland ne kaha use koi turant khatra nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic me NATO-Russia tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.
